scenes.title: An assistant inside every screen
scenes.subtitle: Reads the message. Prepares the next step.
scenes.narration: This is the assistant inside TravelCRM Pro. It reads incoming messages and prepares the next step.
A WhatsApp enquiry arrives in the shared inbox. The assistant has already read it, and marked the message with a suggestion.
It pulls out the destinations, dates, travellers and budget from the message. One click on Create lead sets up the contact and the lead, with nothing typed.
On the lead, the assistant has already scheduled a follow-up, drafted a reply, and picked the closest itinerary template for this trip.
The drafted reply opens in a compose window. You read it, change it if you like, and then send.
Every automation can be switched off, set to suggest, or set to run automatically. Messages and money always ask first.

scenes.heading: From message to next step
scenes.narration: So the path is short. A message arrives, the assistant reads it, a suggestion appears, and one click puts it into action.

scenes.headline: Your team sells. The assistant keeps up.
scenes.cta: See it on your own enquiries
